failure_reason: Site is not a technical/bot block but a genuine business closure: Denby Retail Limited (and related Denby Group entities) entered administration (UK insolvency proceedings) on 31 March 2026. As of this check (2026-09-02), every page on denbypottery.com -- including the previously-extracted https://www.denbypottery.com/collections/pet-bowls -- serves only a static 'CLOSED' notice (confirmed via both a plain HTTP fetch and a real Claude-in-Chrome browser session, byte-identical content, no product listing rendered at all) explaining the administration and that site operation transferred to a new entity, Denby Home Pottery Limited, on 4 June 2026. No storefront, navigation, or product data is currently reachable on this domain by any means -- this is not something a different access tier or a re-fetch would resolve, since the content itself has been replaced sitewide.
notes: ORIGINAL EXTRACTION (this session, earlier the same day, 2026-09-02) found: Denby (denbypottery.com), Shopline platform, direct HTTP fetch worked with no WAF/blocking. Checked full mega-menu collection list and sitemap_collections_1.xml -- only 3 pet-related collections existed site-wide: pet-bowls, new-pet-gifts, pet-owner-gifts. INCLUDED 'Pet Bowls' (collections/pet-bowls), qty=18, verified via 'Showing 18 out of 18 products' rendered header, product titles confirmed genuine ceramic dog/cat bowls. EXCLUDED 'New Pet Gifts' (duplicate listing of the same 18 products, marketing page) and 'Pet Owner Gifts' (mixed human-tableware gift-guide page). No pet food/consumable or medical/veterinary categories found. -- CORRECTION 2026-09-02, same day, later: the user reported the pet-bowls URL 'showing closed' when opened in a browser. Re-checked via both a plain HTTP fetch (python requests, found 'administrat[ion]' text present in the raw HTML at byte offset ~173835) and a real Claude-in-Chrome browser session (screenshot confirmed a literal 'CLOSED' graphic plus the full administration notice, zero product content) -- the site's storefront content has been fully replaced by a company-insolvency notice since the original extraction ran. This is a genuine same-day site-state change (company in administration since 31 March 2026, transferred to a new operator 4 June 2026), not a caching artifact or access-tier issue: both fetch methods now consistently show the closure notice and nothing else. The qty=18 finding above is retained here for historical reference only and must NOT be treated as current -- the row has been dropped from the merged output and the company's ledger status changed to reflect that Pet Care can no longer be verified on this domain as it currently stands. If this site's operations resume under the new owner (Denby Home Pottery Limited) with a working storefront, this SR should be re-extracted fresh rather than reverted to the qty=18 finding above, since a new operator may have a different catalog entirely.
